sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Wet Job - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "We have run this Artyom through our database. It seems he lived in the health resort after the conflict and may have been connected to TerraGroup, but it is unconfirmed, no precise info yet. The nature of their joint operation with the fisherman is also not completely clear, but, considering how secretive their meetings were, I'm pretty sure it's some kind of military tech. We need to find where exactly Artyom’s quarters were, the info could be in the list of Health Resort tenants, which has to be in the administration office, if it is still intact, of course. Find those documents and bring them to me."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain the list of the resort's tenants on Shoreline
- Hand over the item

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- 1,900 Dollars
  - 1,995 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 2,185 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 5× 7.62x51mm M80A1 ammo pack (20 pcs)
- 5× M67 hand grenade
- Unlocks craft for 7.62x51mm M80A1 at Workbench level 3
"The documents are intact? Good work, my friend. We will check the data for the information we need. Your reward."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Sliderkey Flash drive | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
The flash drive with the information can be found in the administration part (theatre wing) of the resort, on a desk in an office on the eastern side on the top floor.
